-- 1. Add subtitle column to design_package_items
ALTER TABLE design_package_items ADD COLUMN subtitle varchar(500) DEFAULT '' AFTER name;

-- 2. Rename "3D Rendering — Large Bathroom / Area" to "3D Rendering — Large Bathroom / Living Room"
UPDATE design_package_items SET name = '3D Rendering — Large Bathroom / Living Room' WHERE name = '3D Rendering — Large Bathroom / Area';

-- 3. Set the Large Bathroom / Living Room rendering to isDefaultEnabled = 0 (opt-in)
UPDATE design_package_items SET isDefaultEnabled = 0 WHERE renderingType = 'large_bathroom';

-- 4. Create dp_feasibility_config table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dp_feasibility_config (
  id int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  price decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000.00',
  repCommission decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '250.00',
  drafterCost decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '500.00',
  description varchar(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A feasibility study determines if your addition is structurally and legally viable before committing to a full design package. Includes a site visit, preliminary drawings, and a written report.',
  tags varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Zoning Review,Structural Assessment,Preliminary Drawings,Cost Validation',
  createdAt timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  updatedAt timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT dp_feasibility_config_id PRIMARY KEY(id)
);

-- 5. Seed the default row
INSERT INTO dp_feasibility_config (id, price, repCommission, drafterCost, description, tags)
VALUES (1, 1000.00, 250.00, 500.00, 'A feasibility study determines if your addition is structurally and legally viable before committing to a full design package. Includes a site visit, preliminary drawings, and a written report.', 'Zoning Review,Structural Assessment,Preliminary Drawings,Cost Validation')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id;
